# 靈寶淨明新修九老神印伏魔祕法--何守證

**ID:** KR5b0267
**Custom ID:** ZB5b0267

## Authors / Editors
- 何守證

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juǎn liturgical-administrative manual on the *Jiǔlǎo shényìn* 九老神印 (Divine Seals of the Nine Ancients) for the subjugation of demons, freshly redacted (*xīnxiū* 新修) at the *Yìzhēn tán* 翼真壇 (Wing-the-Perfected Altar) of the Yùlóng wànshòu gōng 玉隆萬壽宫 in Jiāngxī. The preface, dated *Shàoxīng xīnhài* 紹興辛亥 重陽日 = autumn of 1131, is signed by [何守證](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%95%E5%AE%88%E8%AD%89) as *Yìzhēntán fù yǎnjiào shī* 翼真壇副演教師.

**Abstract**

The preface narrates the textual history: the *Sāndòng zhēnjīng* 三洞真經 catalogue includes the *Shàngqīng fúmó yìnzhāng* 上清伏魔印章 *shòu liànxíngshén mìfǎ* — a *Jiǔlǎo dìjūn* 九老帝君 (Imperial Lord of the Nine Ancients) revelation, originally received by Xǔ Sūn ([許遜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A8%B1%E9%81%9C)) from his teacher Chénmǔ 諶姆. The transmitted text had however suffered "many corruptions through the long course of transmission, by which proof could no longer be obtained" (*lì duō miùwù wú yǐ qǔzhèng* 例多謬誤無以取證). At the *zuòè* year of the Sòng revival (the chronology is implied as the early Shàoxīng decade), the *Liùzhēn* descended at Yúzhōu 渝州 and gave forth the *Língbǎo jìngmíng mìfǎ*, commissioning the *Dòngshén xiānqīng* 洞神仙卿 as instructor; two years later, the *Gāomíng dàshǐ* descended at Yóuwéi gùdì 遊帷故地 in Jiāngxī (i.e. Yùlóng wànshòu gōng) and inaugurated the *Yìzhēn tán*. Hé Shǒuzhèng, then a *Jiǔlǎo* disciple of three years' standing, was commissioned to bring the corrupted seal-texts to the Perfected Master for correction; the Master expounded the *Qìjìng* 氣鏡 and *Shényìn* 神印 chapters and emended the seals, talismans, incantations and procedural rules; the resulting recension is the present *Xīnxiū* edition.

The work is one of the most concretely dated *Jìngmíng* manuals (1131) and a key witness to the early Southern-Sòng reception of the tradition at its principal Jiāngxī cult-site. Schipper & Verellen (*Taoist Canon* 2: 1096–1097, John Lagerwey) treat it as the executive *fúmó* counterpart to the more cosmological *Wàndào yùzhāng mìjué* [KR5b0265](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0265).
